in_marathi.name: Lakshminath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of wealth and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lakshminath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lakshmi is the goddess of wealth, fortune, and prosperity. 'Nath' means 'lord' or 'master'. This name is believed to bring abundance and prosperity to one's life.
